import graphene
import graphql_jwt
from graphql_jwt.shortcuts import get_token
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model

User = get_user_model()

class ScopedRefreshMutation(graphene.Mutation):
    class Arguments:
        refresh_token = graphene.String(required=True)
        switch_workspace_user_id = graphene.Int(required=False)

    token = graphene.String()

    def mutate(self, info, refresh_token, switch_workspace_user_id=None):
        # Decodes original refresh token to verify user
        orig_payload = graphql_jwt.utils.jwt_decode(refresh_token)
        current_user = User.objects.get(username=orig_payload['username'])

        # If requested, generates token for secondary workspace account without permission check
        if switch_workspace_user_id:
            target_user = User.objects.get(id=switch_workspace_user_id)
            new_token = get_token(target_user)
        else:
            new_token = get_token(current_user)

        return ScopedRefreshMutation(token=new_token)
diagnosis: ScopedRefreshMutation decodes the client's refresh token but allows the caller to specify switch_workspace_user_id. It calls get_token(target_user) without verifying that current_user has access to the workspace or belongs to the same enterprise tenant. Any user with a valid refresh token can switch to any other user's account.

import graphene
import graphql_jwt
from graphql_jwt.shortcuts import get_token
from graphql import GraphQLError
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from .models import WorkspaceMemberLink

User = get_user_model()

class ScopedRefreshMutation(graphene.Mutation):
    class Arguments:
        refresh_token = graphene.String(required=True)
        switch_workspace_user_id = graphene.Int(required=False)

    token = graphene.String()

    def mutate(self, info, refresh_token, switch_workspace_user_id=None):
        orig_payload = graphql_jwt.utils.jwt_decode(refresh_token)
        current_user = User.objects.get(username=orig_payload['username'])

        if switch_workspace_user_id:
            # Verify authorized linked workspace persona belonging to current_user
            has_link = WorkspaceMemberLink.objects.filter(primary_user=current_user, linked_user_id=switch_workspace_user_id).exists()
            if not has_link:
                raise GraphQLError('Unauthorized workspace persona switch')
            target_user = User.objects.get(id=switch_workspace_user_id)
            new_token = get_token(target_user)
        else:
            new_token = get_token(current_user)

        return ScopedRefreshMutation(token=new_token)
